label: Hyperliquid Spot (public info)
notes: Reads need only the public wallet address; the private key of an agent wallet is never used by this server (writes are not offered).
terms_note: Public POST /info endpoint, no credentials (a wallet address is enough to read its balances and orders). Orders need an EIP-712 wallet signature and are not mapped.

discovery.auth: none (public info); signed exchange endpoint not mapped

rate_limits: aggregated REST weight 1200 per minute per IP; l2Book, spotClearinghouseState weight 2; spotMeta and openOrders weight 20

config_fields.name: wallet_address
config_fields.help: Public 0x address (42 hex characters) of the MAIN wallet whose orders/balances to read. Not a secret; no private key is needed or accepted. Only list_orders/get_balances use it.

me.note: Public info endpoint, no credentials: the probe posts {"type": "spotMeta"} (weight 20).

list_markets.note: Spot pairs in one response (`query` is not sent). Canonical pairs are named like PURR/USDC; others are @<index> (e.g. @107), which is also the coin name get_ticker expects. `raw.tokens` holds token indices, resolved in spotMeta.tokens.

get_ticker.note: Top of the spot L2 book (weight 2); `symbol` is PURR/USDC or @<index>. No last price or 24h volume per symbol (spotMetaAndAssetCtxs is a positional array).

list_orders.note: Open orders of the configured wallet (perp and spot alike; spot coins appear as PURR/USDC or @<index>); `side` is B (buy) or A (sell).

not_offered.get_candles: candleSnapshot requires req.startTime and req.endTime in milliseconds (docs: both required); the vocabulary carries no time range and the runtime has no millisecond clock expression.
not_offered.place_order: orders and cancels go through POST /exchange with an EIP-712 typed-data signature produced by the wallet's secp256k1 private key (docs: 'signing … is done with the private key of the agent or main wallet'); the runtime only has HMAC request signing, so writes are not offered
not_offered.cancel_order: orders and cancels go through POST /exchange with an EIP-712 typed-data signature produced by the wallet's secp256k1 private key (docs: 'signing … is done with the private key of the agent or main wallet'); the runtime only has HMAC request signing, so writes are not offered

auth: 2. /exchange requires an EIP-712 signature from the wallet (not mapped).

endpoints.notes: universe[{name, tokens, index, isCanonical}], tokens[{name, szDecimals, weiDecimals, index, tokenId, isCanonical}]

live_check.notes: fixed: ticker bid/ask were decimal strings (schema-invalid); now numbers. Account tools verified with the public zero address (empty lists); also: next_page now null (no page parameter); all read tools answered, schema-valid
